summary: Follow source through virtual instructions to architecture-specific machine code and use inspection to test compiler hypotheses.
outcomes: Distinguish PTX from native SASS and describe JIT/AOT paths.
Explain one source-to-instruction transformation and its tradeoff.
sequence: Compile a small load/arithmetic kernel with visible intermediate output.
Identify virtual instructions, predicates and register usage.
Inspect native instructions and resource metadata.
Compare unrolling, vectorization, FMA and spills.
Measure the actual result without assigning fixed latency to every instruction.

visual.question: Which source choice introduced these extra instructions or local-memory accesses?
visual.interaction: Select a source variant and highlight the relevant changes.

practice.success: Report links source, binary evidence and a controlled benchmark on a named architecture.
